description.en: Korean language pack for DeepSeek Harness: 65 dictionaries, scoped Pretendard typography, marketplace-ready.
description.ko: 딥시크 하네스 한국어 언어팩: 65개 사전, Pretendard 타이포그래피, 마켓 등록 지원.

release.notes: v0.2.2 fixes Korean font-stack persistence across reloads. The scoped stylesheet now binds both --dsh-font-family-text and --dsw-font-family at :root:lang(ko) and on body, applies the text seat directly to body text, and keeps code/terminal monospace seats and explicit Settings fonts authoritative. Docs follow the global standard: English README.md plus a reciprocal Korean README.ko.md.
